claim: The GIE README states in an IMPORTANT notice that EPP, InferenceObjective, InferenceModelRewrite APIs, and BBR have moved to new repositories and will no longer accept new code in kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api-inference-extension, with EPP moving specifically to llm-d/llm-d-router.
stance_target: EPP development has moved to the llm-d-router repository, which is the correct target repo for customization work
scope_conditions: GIE README, current as of commit ebbb148c (2026-06-30), originally announced 2026-05-02
quoted_support: The Endpoint Picker (EPP), InferenceObjective and InferenceModelRewrite APIs, and Body Based Router (BBR) packages have moved to new repositories: EPP and associated APIs: llm-d/llm-d-router. No new code will be accepted to these packages in this repository, and they will be archived soon.

claim: The repository originally announced the EPP move on 2026-05-02 naming the destination as llm-d/llm-d-inference-scheduler; the link was renamed to llm-d/llm-d-router on 2026-06-30, indicating the destination repo itself was renamed from llm-d-inference-scheduler to llm-d-router between those dates.
stance_target: exact timeline of the EPP-to-llm-d-router migration
quoted_support: EPP and associated APIs: [llm-d/llm-d-inference-scheduler](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-inference-scheduler) [changed to] EPP and associated APIs: [llm-d/llm-d-router](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-router)

claim: The kubernetes-sigs repository will continue to host the lightweight EPP (LWEPP), the InferencePool API, and conformance tests, rather than being fully archived.
stance_target: what remains in the upstream GIE repo after the EPP migration
quoted_support: This repository will continue to host the lightweight EPP (LWEPP) and the InferencePool API, and will remain the primary location for the development and maintenance of conformance tests.

claim: A dead-code-cleanup PR was explicitly reverted in part to preserve exported Go API surfaces because llm-d depends on them as a framework SDK contract, showing llm-d consumes GIE's EPP framework as a library rather than a fully separate codebase.
stance_target: llm-d-router remains dependent on / derived from GIE's EPP framework internals, not a clean-room reimplementation
quoted_support: Downstream projects (like llm-d) rely on these exported symbols as a framework SDK contract. Restored APIs: PluginByType in pkg/epp/framework/interface/plugin/handle.go, ReadCycleStateKey in pkg/epp/framework/interface/scheduling/cycle_state.go, With* configuration options for Runner in cmd/epp/runner/runner.go.

claim: The README's glossary redefines the EPP as a data-plane component acting as 'the Router' communicating via the Envoy ext-proc protocol, replacing the earlier framing of the EPP as merely an 'Inference Scheduler' -- language aligned with rebranding it toward the llm-d Router.
stance_target: terminology shift accompanying the llm-d-router migration
quoted_support: Endpoint Picker (EPP): A data-plane component that communicates via the Envoy external processing protocol, and acts as the Router. It intercepts incoming inference requests and routes each request to the optimal model server replica.
